name: politecnicojic.edu.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.politecnicojic.edu.co scores 59 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 41 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 21 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-informacion-publica, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania, /participa and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 44 images are more than twice the size shown
fix.evidence: captura-notas.jpg on / (1200×630 shown at 268×140, 95 KB, about 76 KB to save), ruta-empleabilidad-estudiantes-graduado… on / (1200×630 shown at 268×140, 85 KB, about 68 KB to save), 5-encuentro-ingenieria-innovacion-soste… on / (1200×630 shown at 310×163,…
fix.fix: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset and sizes.

fix.title: 77 images below the first screen load straight away
fix.evidence: inscripciones-pregrados-2027-1.webp on /, inscripciones-posgrados-2027-1.webp on /, evolucionamos-para-servirte-mejor.webp on /, se-parte-jornada-poli-investiga.webp on / and 73 more. They compete with the first screen for bandwidth.
fix.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the first screen, and keep it off the main image.
